players.product: enterprise PCIe Gen5 SSD controllers for hyperscaler SSDs

quarterly_data.signal: Correction filing for the 03-13-2026 enterprise SSD controller supply contract with an undisclosed domestic semiconductor manufacturer (order accepted 03-12-2026; outsourced production; domestic supply; payment within 30 days of product receipt; FADU has performed same-type contracts with it in the past three years): the delivery dates of part of the volume were adjusted in consultation with the customer, so the contract end date (the product payment date) and the disclosure-withholding deadline move from 10-17-2026 to 11-23-2026; the counterparty is withheld at its request
quarterly_data.figure: USD 6,813,500 (KRW 10,075,803,800 at the PO exchange rate of 1,478.8), 23.16% of 2024 consolidated revenue; end date 11-23-2026 (was 10-17-2026)
